description: Sign someone up for one time on an open Registration Sheet. TroopRally emails the attendee a confirmation. Check with the organizer before registering someone on their behalf.

answers.description: Answers to the rally's custom fields (see list_custom_fields). Every required field needs one. For an image field, upload the image with upload_custom_field_image and pass the answer it returns. For a dropdown field, pass one of its options as answer, or several as selected_options.

answer.description: The answer text. For a dropdown field, one of its options.

selected_options.description: For a dropdown field: the options chosen, each exactly as list_custom_fields gives it. More than one only where the field's allowMultiple is true. Pass this or answer, not both.

attendee_email.description: Where TroopRally sends the attendee's confirmation.

attendee_name.description: The attendee's name as it should appear.

slot_id.description: The time to sign up for (slotId from list_time_slots).
